newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia card rates a concern - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia card rates a concern - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday that credit card interest rates remained a concern for the government.

"Of course I've raised it with the banks and why wouldn't I? Because credit card interest rates are a matter of concern," Costello told parliament in response to a question on whether he intended to press the banks to lower credit card interest rates.
Banks are yet to cut credit card interest rates in the wake of the official interest rate cut on July 31 when the Reserve Bank reduced rates to 7.0 percent from 7.5 percent.
Costello said increased competition in the financial sector would help cut credit card margins.
Credit card rates currently ranged from 12.5 percent to 21.95 percent, the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported in late October.
